recommendation: GO for publication of this source-bound frontend inventory checkpoint
scope: Independent local code/diff review and browser regression of automatic read-only owned-original inventory selection. Addendum to the earlier contract and frontend reviews; no contract or deployment authorization is granted.

resolved: Incomplete history responses now reset the cached scan cursor to genesis, so refresh can recover old holdings instead of reusing a poisoned recent-only cursor.
Original-code verification failure now disables every write gate and invalidates prior consent; preflight rechecks the exact original runtime before either approval or mint.
Nonexistent extra cached candidates no longer poison a complete balance-matched currently-owned set; completed caches retain only verified owned IDs.

checks: Automatic discovery is read-only and is available with an undeployed or unfunded GGOO collection; original chain/address/runtime must verify first.
Separate scan epoch plus account and chain identity rejects stale responses, including A-to-B-to-A, Base exit/return, Stop and refresh races.
Incoming logs are collection/event/recipient/ID validated. Owner and balance reconciliation uses one pinned block. Current ownership is rechecked before each write.
At most 13 unique in-range IDs can be selected; manual-ID fallback remains available.
Recipe cards use bounded enums/count and strict RGB hex data, lazy three-call concurrency, and a bounded cache. Malicious cache values are discarded.
No tokenURI, imageURI, GIF, script or remote artwork loader is introduced. Original art links use the fixed Basescan collection URL.
No automatic approval or mint. Separate explicit broad-approval and exact-13 permanent-custody consent remain required.
Existing runtime/wiring/oracle quote/cap/reserve, explicit gasPrice, account/chain, durable intent, receipt recipient/provenance and pending reveal safeguards pass regression.
The 390px inventory screenshot was visually inspected: clear 13/13 counter, read-only status and selectable bounded-trait cards.

limitations: Browser wallet and Base RPC were mocked in local headless Chromium. No physical-wallet or live-wallet holdings test, transaction, approval, funding or NFT transfer was performed.
RPC availability, history completeness and chain reorganizations remain external limitations; refresh and manual-ID fallback may be needed.
Inventory ownership is a pinned-block snapshot. A later transfer can change eligibility; preflight and the contract enforce current ownership.
This is automated/local security review, not a formal external audit. Existing mandatory live Base preflight and direct owner wallet confirmation remain required.
